description: Look up a Sonic transaction by hash: sender, recipient, value in S, nonce, gas limit, the 4-byte function selector and its block. Use to see what was sent or whether it exists; for success or failure and fees paid use sonic_receipt, for emitted events sonic_logs. Input is a 0x-prefixed 64-hex hash; an unknown hash returns 404, uncharged. Example: hash=0xcc6a5594962b5211496391d0e1e9082f5060f218fad60f907a23e85a7b02bf85. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: sonic_tx
title: Sonic transaction
